name: Microsoft Corp
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Zoya: NOT HALAL. Both major screeners reject. Likely fails interest-bearing securities ratio — Microsoft holds massive cash/securities that may push ratio above 30%. Interest income $3.16B / ~$248B revenue = 1.27%. Muslim Xchange and Islamicly say compliant, and MSFT is held in HLAL/SPUS ETFs — but the two primary screeners (Musaffa+Zoya) both say no.
notes: Most contested stock. 2 screeners fail, 2 pass + held in halal ETFs. Erring on side of caution. Re-evaluate quarterly — if Musaffa or Zoya flip, promote to watchlist.

name: Costco Wholesale Corp
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Costco is the world's largest alcohol retailer. Alcohol revenue ~4.26% of total — just below the 5% AAOIFI threshold. Also sells pork and tobacco. Muslim Xchange says compliant. Islamicly reports 4.26% prohibited income.
notes: Right at the edge of 5% impure revenue. Any increase in alcohol sales could push over. Too close to threshold for comfort.

name: Honeywell International Inc
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Defense revenue ~13-15% of total revenue. Provides guidance systems, inertial measurement units for guided bombs/missiles/drones. Involved in U.S. nuclear weapons program. Muslim Xchange says compliant.
notes: Defense exposure is the issue. 15% defense revenue is well above 5% impure revenue threshold. Nuclear weapons involvement is particularly concerning.

name: Deere & Co
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Muslim Xchange: NOT COMPLIANT. John Deere Financial provides interest-bearing loans and financing — this is conventional lending (riba). The financial services arm is a major segment.
notes: Embedded financial services/lending business is the primary disqualifier. Equipment business itself is permissible.

name: GE Aerospace
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Muslim Xchange: NOT COMPLIANT. Defense & Propulsion Technologies segment ~$9B / $32B total revenue = ~28% defense. Produces engines for F-15, F-16, Black Hawk, Apache military platforms.
notes: 28% defense revenue is well above 5% threshold. Clear non-compliant.

name: NextEra Energy Inc
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Muslim Xchange: NOT COMPLIANT. Zoya: NOT COMPLIANT. Debt-to-equity ratio 1.83 — extremely high leverage. Utilities typically carry heavy debt, pushing interest-bearing debt/market cap above 30%. Business (renewable energy) is perfectly halal — fails purely on financial screen.
notes: Common pattern: utilities fail on leverage, not business activity. Clean energy thesis is good but financial structure fails AAOIFI.

name: Pfizer Inc
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Debt ~$64.8B / MCap ~$155.6B = ~41.6% — clearly exceeds 30% AAOIFI threshold. Impure revenue only 0.96% (passes). Muslim Xchange says compliant (likely uses different methodology).
notes: Debt from Seagen acquisition ($43B) is the sole issue. Pharmaceutical business is permissible. As debt is paid down and/or market cap recovers, could become compliant. Monitor quarterly.

name: Amgen Inc
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Zoya: NOT COMPLIANT. Muslim Xchange: NOT COMPLIANT (passes 0 of 5 standards). Debt ~$60.9B / MCap ~$190B = ~32% — exceeds 30% threshold.
notes: Unanimous non-compliant across all screeners. Horizon Therapeutics acquisition debt. Actively deleveraging ($4.3B retired in H1 2025). Could potentially cross threshold in future.

name: UnitedHealth Group Inc
rejection_reason: PROHIBITED INDUSTRY: Conventional insurance. Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Zoya: NOT COMPLIANT. Sharlife: FAILED. Amal Invest: HARAM. Insurance involves gharar (excessive uncertainty), maysir (gambling-like risk transfer), and riba (interest) in premium investment.
notes: Automatic reject — core business is conventional insurance. Unanimous across all screeners.

name: Lockheed Martin Corp
rejection_reason: PROHIBITED INDUSTRY: Weapons manufacturing. 100% revenue from military systems (F-35, Trident missiles, Javelin, missile defense). Unanimous HARAM across all screeners.
notes: Clearest exclusion in Islamic investing. No debate.

name: RTX Corp (Raytheon)
rejection_reason: PROHIBITED INDUSTRY: Weapons and defense. Core business across all three segments (Collins Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, Raytheon) is defense-oriented. Unanimous HARAM across all screeners.

name: Intuit Inc
rejection_reason: Musaffa: NOT HALAL. Owns Credit Karma (consumer lending/credit services) and QuickBooks Capital (small business lending). Financial services subsidiaries generate interest-based income.
notes: Core tax/accounting software (TurboTax, QuickBooks) is fine — lending divisions are the issue.
